crossRefs.note: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against Yahweh your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly…
I fell down before Yahweh, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because…

translations.web: So I fell down before Yahweh the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because Yahweh had said he would destroy you.
translations.bsb: So I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights, because the LORD had said He would destroy you.
